description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of time costs before and after efficient deployment, representing a comparison of two time measurements. The chart contains two slices: “Reduction,” which is orange and occupies approximately 69.92% of the chart, and “Efficient deployment,” which is blue and occupies approximately 30.08% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, showing 60.9s (69.92%) for “Reduction” and 26.2s (30.08%) for “Efficient deployment.” The “Efficient deployment” slice is slightly offset from the rest of the chart. The slices are ordered from largest to smallest, visually progressing clockwise. A legend is not present, but each slice is directly labeled.
caption_used: Efficient deployment methods significantly reduce the time cost, with the average total time cost before efficient deployment being 92.5s (30.5s + 62s). This represents a reduction of approximately 72.5% after efficient deployment, highlighting the substantial impact of optimization strategies.
